name: crbm-securities-pipelines
description: CRB Monitor new-securities sort pipelines (Google Apps Script) - DARB and CRB - with GitHub auto-deploy via clasp.

scripts.check: npm run check:darb && npm run check:crb
scripts.check:darb: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('Macro - DARB Identification/Code.gs','/tmp/darb_check.js')" && node --check /tmp/darb_check.js && echo "Syntax OK - DARB"
scripts.check:crb: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('Macro - CRB Identification/Code.gs','/tmp/crb_check.js')" && node --check /tmp/crb_check.js && echo "Syntax OK - CRB"
scripts.test: npm run test:darb && npm run test:crb
